scope: Reference-based game reconstructions, not surveyed or photogrammetric replicas. Other city buildings use mapped footprints and regional architectural families.

landmarks.name: Academy Building
landmarks.modeled: Four-story red-brick street block, arched upper windows, pale stone bands, pilasters and green retail awnings. Proportions approximate.

landmarks.name: Fall River Government Center
landmarks.modeled: Exposed concrete volumes, recessed glazed middle section, projecting upper sun fins, elevated base. Site elevations simplified.

landmarks.name: Lizzie Borden House
landmarks.modeled: Green clapboard, dark shutters, light trim, gabled roof and central entrance; mapped building footprint.

landmarks.name: Fall River Justice Center
landmarks.modeled: Mapped curved footprint with modern glazing and pale masonry; exterior interpretation, not exact panel layout.

materials.usage: Lighting and material reflections only; the game sky is generated and foreign architecture is not used as the background.

vehicle.modeled: Original stylized geometry with crossover proportions, glass roof, dark trim and current light-bar cues; no official Tesla mesh or texture is included.

character.asset: Generated rigged character and in-place Idle, Walk and Run animations
character.animation: Walk and Run derived from CMU Graphics Lab Motion Capture Database; the data may not be resold on its own. The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.
character.notes: A generated character inspired by the supplied reference, not an exact likeness. Runtime material tint gives the outfit a tan palette. See models/PLAYER-LICENSE.txt.
